title: Linking Al-Infitar 1 to 16 and checking memory: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Al-Infitar, ghunnah and the sifat in practice
source: Written for quran/y6 lesson 37 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Linking Al-Infitar 1 to 16 and checking memory rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 37. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

head: Ayat
Theme
rows: The sky, stars, seas and graves; each soul knows its deeds
O man, what deceived you about your Generous Lord?

arabic.text: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ (٥) يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ (٦)

keywords.def: joining the end of one ayah to the start of the next

questions.q: Chain recitation of 82:1 to 16, one ayah per pupil.
Rota: today's group recites 82:1 to 16 to the teacher. Everyone else: practise the three joins (3-3-link) and log them.
Extend: recite Al-Inshiqaq 1 to 10 from the rota.
Recite Al-Infitar 82:14 in your head. How does the next ayah begin?
Think again: Where do you usually get stuck when reciting a surah: the beginning, the joins between parts, or the end?
questions.a: Usually at the joins: we practise the last ayah of one part with the first of the next.
